themes.name: AI Compute & HBM
themes.description: GPUs, custom silicon, HBM memory, advanced packaging and the foundry at the centre.

themes.name: AI Optics & Interconnect
themes.description: Optical transceivers, lasers, fibre and cables, switching silicon and the networking layer of AI clusters.

themes.name: AI Power & Nuclear
themes.description: Power generation, grid equipment, cooling, nuclear fuel and reactors feeding data-centre demand.

themes.name: Defense
themes.description: Prime contractors and the Korean / Japanese export champions.

themes.name: Robotics & Automation

themes.name: Shipbuilding & Shipping
themes.description: Korean yards, container lines, bulkers and tankers.

themes.name: Precious & Critical Metals
themes.description: Gold, silver, copper and critical-minerals miners.

themes.name: Fintech & Trading Platforms
themes.description: Exchanges and market infrastructure, retail brokers, payments and neobanks — the "activity" trade (volumes, volatility, retail participation) rather than bank balance sheets.

themes.name: Biotech & GLP-1
themes.description: Obesity franchises, large biotech, CDMOs and Asian innovators.

themes.name: China AI & Semis
themes.description: Domestic AI compute, foundry, optics, platforms and the 2026 Hong Kong AI listings (Z.ai, MiniMax, Biren, Iluvatar).

themes.name: AI Software & Agents
themes.description: Agentic-AI winners and the "software disruption" debate — platforms, security and the listed model labs. Add Anthropic and OpenAI here on listing.

themes.name: Quantum Computing
themes.description: Pure-play quantum names — a sentiment/liquidity theme that trades with risk appetite.

themes.name: Energy Security & Oil
themes.description: Oil and gas producers, refiners and services — the Brent > $100 / US–Iran trade and the energy-importer stress it causes in Asia.
